findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query, errors, web_vitals · Private data: set_project_context, append_project_annotation, sessions · Public sink: query, errors, web_vitals · Destructive: delete_experiment, query, compare, analytics_funnel, analytics_paths.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query, errors, web_vitals · Private data: set_project_context, append_project_annotation, sessions · Public sink: query, errors, web_vitals · Destructive: delete_experiment, query, compare, analytics_funnel, analytics_paths

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_project" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
